head: 1969ab2

rows.evidence: java.lang.AssertionError: app.md defaultCache row omits the relay exception: `defaultCache(policy)` | Cache-Control을 지정하지 않은 응답의 기본 정책. `null`이면 생략 | [정적 파일](static.md#서버-기본-정책) (LpWave8R2DocsProbeTest.java:16; 43 tests completed, 1 failed). en/app.md:110 has the same gap: 'Policy for responses without Cache-Control; null omits it'.
rows.note: docs/api/app.md:117 and docs/api/en/app.md:110 describe app.defaultCache as the policy for every response without Cache-Control and do not state that res.relay never receives it. The fix commit 1969ab2 covered static, defaults and response pages only. This row sits outside the three pages the task names in parentheses, but it is a place that describes app.defaultCache. Drop it if the parenthetical list is the full scope.
Over a real TinyHttpd socket, the client gets two appended Set-Cookie lines in order.
header X:1 then append X:2 reaches the client as two lines over TinyHttpd, so the adapter does not merge them.
Checks the documented claim over a real socket: no Content-Type, no Cache-Control under defaultCache(noCache), Content-Length 5.
Checks the documented claim that a longer stream is cut at contentLength.

Checks the documented onAbort claims: no call after a normal completion (even with a later res.abort), a single call on a double abort, and a run at once when the listener is registered after the abort.
